newsitem.title: USA: IMAX. Lockheed to make space film.
newsitem.headline: IMAX. Lockheed to make space film.

text.p: IMAX Corp and Lockheed Martin Corp said Tuesday that they reached an agreement for the production of a documentary film on the construction of the International Space Station.
The two companies said in a news release that the large-format three-dimensional film would be the first one of its kind to be made in space by IMAX.

Canada's IMAX had to sign an agreement with the U.S. National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) to be able to make the film about the station, a partnership of 15 countries, involving the United States, Russia and the European Space Agency.
Lockheed, which has sponsored four IMAX films about space, will do the same for the new one.
Based in Bethesda, Maryland, Lockheed Martin develops advanced-technology products for the space and aeronautics industries, among others.
